scope: Short P0→O→C→K0 roadmap Round 3A; conditional conversion-target comparison above the frozen Round-2 opportunity winner. Research only; no canonical/live change.

contract.frozen_opportunity: MFE6 > 250 bps; target-specific stable 45 fields; uniform training weight; strict-OOF Platt calibration
contract.conversion_population: only true O-positive training rows; all target-free held rows scored

decision.definition: five-state ordinalized negative normalized regret; high score means the H12 policy captured a larger share of the defined opportunity
decision.reason: best two-era mean and material CVaR improvement; its 78.5% participation clears the 70% gate. Its more negative worst month must be monitored in subsequent C feature/weight work.

caveat: 2025–2026 are sequential model-selection evidence, not an untouched promotion period.
